name: @local/dsh-workbench
description: Workbench: a private shelf of configured volumes for everyday, non-coding work. Boards, sub-boards, fixed prompts, skill selections, remembered model and reasoning choices, to-dos, reminders, notes and per-board working areas all stay intact; the workbench page and its Settings section share one press vocabulary — cloth covers, a row of mini cover fronts, an inner page and a day drawer.
